research.facts:
USA WNT Group Oklahoma — Two Days Out
**Source 1:** wbsc.org (official)
- Tournament: WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Stage, Oklahoma City (Group Oklahoma)
- Dates: September 12–16, 2026
- Venue: Devon Park (OGE Energy Field), Oklahoma City
- Format: 6-team round-robin + play-offs on Sept. 16
- USA vs No. 7 Mexico — opening night Sept. 12, 7:30 PM local (CDT) / Opening Ceremony 6:30 PM
- 6 teams: No. 1 USA, No. 6 Netherlands, No. 7 Mexico, No. 8 China, No. 17 Brazil, No. 23 New Zealand (NOT South Africa — confirmed WBSC)
- Netherlands (No. 6) — top-seed decider in round-robin
- Top 2 advance to 2027 WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Finals, Redcliffe, Queensland (April 5–11, 2027) — LA28 Olympic qualifier path
- **Confidence: HIGH** (official tournament listing, wbsc.org)
**Source 2:** usasoftball.com / soonersports.com (official roster)
- 16-player roster: Rachel Garcia (2020 Olympic gold), Dejah Mulipola (2020 Olympic gold)
- 7 members of 2025 World Games gold-medal team
- 10 players from 2025 Down Under Series
- Coaching staff: Patty Gasso (HC), JT Gasso, Jennifer Rocha
- OU has 4 players on WNT roster: Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell
- USA went 5-0 at International Cup at Devon Park earlier in 2026
- USA has won 11 of 14 World Cup editions all-time
- **Confidence: HIGH** (official roster announcements)
**Freshness:** Tournament opens in 2 days (Sept 12).
